com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc

Class DbcFlexDataIterator

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc.DbcFlexDataIterator
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.util.Iterator<java.util.Iterator<FlexDataField>>

    public class DbcFlexDataIterator
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.util.Iterator<java.util.Iterator<FlexDataField>>
    This is an Iterator of the records from the FlexData. Each record has an Iterator of FlexDataFields. The iterator will throw NoSuchElementException if there are no elements left in iteration. The iterator will throw InvalidDataException (a RuntimeException) if flex data received has a protocol error and cannot be parsed according to dictionary specification.
    Since:
    01-024-0000
    Author:
    ICE Data Services
    See Also:
    FlexData, FlexDataField, DbcFlexDataFieldIterator

      • hasNext

        public boolean hasNext()
        Returns true if the iteration has more elements. (In other words, returns true if next would return an element rather than throwing an exception.)
        Specified by:
        hasNext in interface java.util.Iterator<java.util.Iterator<FlexDataField>>
        Returns:
        true if the iterator has more elements.

      • next

        public java.util.Iterator<FlexDataField> next()
        Returns the next element in the iteration. Calling this method repeatedly until the hasNext() method returns false will return each element in the underlying collection exactly once.

        This method will throw InvalidDataException if the data received has a protocol error and can not be read based on the schema specification.

        Specified by:
        next in interface java.util.Iterator<java.util.Iterator<FlexDataField>>
        Returns:
        an Iterator of FlexDataFields.
        Throws:
        java.util.NoSuchElementException - if iteration has no more elements.
        InvalidDataException - if the data received has a protocol error and can not be read based on the schema specification
